title: Sell regulated gas at or below the reasonable price (Gas Market Code)
what: Gas producers must not supply regulated gas under agreements at prices above the Code's reasonable price, and must negotiate in good faith.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Gas Market Code) Regulations 2023

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Gas Market Code) Regulations 2023
sources.quote: 27 Agreement for supply of regulated gas—price for supplied gas exceeds reasonable price (1) A person (the supplier) contravenes this subsection if: (a) the supplier is a covered supplier; and (b) the supplier entered into an agreement for the supply of regulated gas; and (c) the supplier supplies regulated gas under the agreement; and (d) the price payable under the agreement, for that regulated gas, exceeds a reasonable price.

marks.reason: A binding price control in a major input market keeps prices from signalling scarcity.
Price controls and exemptions negotiated case by case add regulatory risk to gas supply investment.
